name: cr608_2b_fused_spell_resolves_with_one_target_left
why: CR 608.2b: a spell doesn't resolve only when all its targets are illegal. Mishra's Bauble sacrificed in response leaves Wear's target illegal, and the fused spell still resolves: Tear destroys the enchantment. A spell with its own first target illegal and a chained instruction's target legal (Wear // Tear; Cloak and Dagger, Entwined's trigger).
